T: Run like the wind. Bake like your mum.
D: Two young sprinters from Western Australia sign up and head for Gallipoli.
P: Serve the biscuits when Archy and Frank meet at the athletics carnival.
S: the biscuits sent to the troops
Rolled oats, flour, coconut and sugar mixed with melted butter, golden syrup and bicarb dissolved in boiling water, rolled, flattened, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
Hummus, baba ganoush and warm flatbread with dukkah, olives and cucumber, a dusting of paprika and plenty of olive oil.
Archy's WA cheese and chive damper
the station in WA where Archy trains with Uncle Jack

A crusty round of damper studded with tasty cheese and chives, baked golden and torn open warm with salted butter. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt. Stir in 120g grated tasty cheese and a handful of chopped chives. Add 300ml milk and mix with a knife into a soft dough. Shape a round on a floured tray, cut a cross on top and scatter with 30g more cheese. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve warm with butter.
M: Frank and Archy's Cairo kofta wraps
Frank and Archy on leave in Cairo

Spiced lamb kofta grilled over high heat, wrapped in warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and cucumber salad, pickled chilli and sumac onions. Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion and toss with 1 tsp sumac. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon. Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber. Grill the kofta 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Wrap in 4 warm flatbreads with everything else.
a family dinner before he enlists
Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, roasted at 180C to 58C, rested, with roast potatoes, pumpkin, peas and gravy.
W: Scone dough dumplings dropped into simmering golden syrup, butter and water, covered and cooked 20 minutes until puffed. Cream or ice cream.
K: brewed in tins by the troops
Strong black tea boiled in a billy for a minute, settled, poured into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar.

s.note: the biscuits sent to the troops
s.how: Mix 90g oats, 150g flour, 85g coconut and 150g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then add 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water. Stir together, roll into balls, flatten and bake at 160C for 15 minutes.

Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.

m.note: a family dinner before he enlists
m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary and roast at 180C until 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin alongside. Cook 300g peas and make gravy from the pan juices.

w.how: Rub 30g butter into 150g self-raising flour and mix in 100ml milk to a soft dough. Bring 375ml water, 100g brown sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 30g butter to a simmer. Drop in spoonfuls of dough, cover and cook 20 minutes. Serve with cream.

d.note: brewed in tins by the troops
d.how: Boil 1.2L water in a billy or pot. Add 3 tbsp loose leaf tea, boil for a minute and swing to settle. Pour into tin mugs with milk and plenty of sugar.
